title: TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours Rate for Installing Rush Hardware Orders
content:
Installation rush schedule: the block hours of a TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours installation visit for an order quoted with rush processing that the desk resolved on the order's delivery date are multiplied by 1.25; those of one for a rush order resolved one to 2 calendar days after delivery, by 1.15; those of any other installation visit, by 1. Rush processing and the delivery date are those on the Hardware Procurement order the installation is priced on; the resolution date is that of the visit's ticket.

| Order quoted with rush processing | Resolution, counted in calendar days from the delivery date | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| yes | same day (day 0) | 1.25 |
| yes | day 1 or day 2 | 1.15 |
| yes | day 3 or later | 1 |
| no | any | 1 |

Hypothetical cases for a rush order delivered on 6 May: resolved 6 May, 1.25; resolved 8 May, 1.15; resolved 9 May, 1. An installation converting to 2.00 hours before this multiplier draws 2.50 hours at 1.25 and 2.30 hours at 1.15.
